name: SOCI 2200W
title: Introducing India: Diversity and Dynamism
description: (Also offered as AAAS 2200W.) An introduction to the historical, political, social, economic, and cultural diversity of India. Topics may include: cultural diversity in languages, religions, and regions; socio-political challenges; power relations that construct patterns of privilege and marginalization; and contemporary human rights issues.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: One introductory AAAS or SOCI course.
